name: OpenCode Go

reset.rule: Opens at your first request and lasts 5 hours. You can spend up to 20% of the month in one window.
stipulations: Before a window starts, the API reports a reset 5 hours from now.

reset.rule: Resets Monday 00:00 UTC. You can spend up to 50% of the month in one week.
Resets when a new paid period starts.
stipulations: If a renewal fails, Go stays active while payment retries at 1, 3 and 7 days, then ends.
A refund is possible within 14 days if you've used almost none of the period.

overage: Rate-limited until the window resets. Free models keep working, with a daily request cap. Extra Usage (off by default) can fall back to your console balance at pay-as-you-go prices.

how: One monthly allowance shared across 28 paid models. Each model's $ cap sets how fast it drains the allowance.
No more than 20% of the month per 5 hours and 50% per week.
ext: This is your plan for models from other labs: Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Grok 4.7 and Gemini 4 Argon, plus Kimi, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax and more.
Works in Claude Code, Codex, Kilo Code CLI, Pi and others through the Go API. Clients must send a stable x-opencode-session header.
quirks: Models from the big labs (Haiku, GPT-6 Luna, Grok) have low $15 caps, so they drain the month fastest.
The documented usage API is GET /inference/go/v1/usage.
By default, paid endpoints that train on your data are blocked.

modelTable.title: OpenCode Go: per-model monthly caps
modelTable.note: Every model spends the same allowance at a different rate. On a $15-cap model, $1.50 of list-price usage is 10% of your month. On DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ($100 cap), the same $1.50 is 1.5%.
modelTable.footer: Plus four free models (Beam, HungerG, Hy4 flash, Iceman) for a limited time, with a daily request cap.
